title: Work, school and ambition
intro: Grades, shifts, big dreams. Let's see what you're actually working for.

cards.prompt: Genii can spoil your whole future right now. Every school, every job, every win, every plot twist. One tap.

options.t: Spoil it. I'd sleep so much better knowing.
Don't you dare. Finding out is the fun part.

cards.mask: looks like a spoiler joke; measures the need for a locked-in path versus keeping the future open (T17, L2 certainty side)

friend.prompt: Genii offers to spoil {name}'s whole future in one tap. What would {they} say?

cards.prompt: Your boss lets you pick your next assignment. One you've done five times and could do half-asleep. Or one nobody on the team has ever tried.
cards.teenPrompt: Next year you get one elective. The sequel to the class you aced, same teacher. Or a brand-new one nobody at school has taken yet.

options.t: The one I could do half-asleep. Surprises are for birthdays.
The brand-new one. Day one, I'm googling everything.
The safe one. One bad review or grade and I'm done.

cards.mask: looks like picking your next assignment or class; measures the sure thing versus the untried (L1) with a new-versus-familiar read (T22). Rewritten in the fix pass so it no longer repeats C5-6's safe-pay-versus-passion fork

friend.prompt: {name} can pick the next assignment: one {they} could do half-asleep, or one nobody has tried. {name} picks…

b.t: The brand-new one nobody has tried.

cards.prompt: Group project, week two. You start the day it's assigned. Your partner starts at 2am the night before it's due.

options.t: Make a shared doc with deadlines a day early. Secretly.
Ask to switch partners. No drama, no hard feelings.

cards.mask: looks like a group-project gripe; measures repairing a bad fit versus letting it go when nobody is at fault (T10, its second card after C3-5)

friend.prompt: {name}'s project partner starts everything at 2am the night before. {name}…

a.t: Builds a system to make it work.

b.t: Asks to switch partners, no drama.

cards.prompt: Your manager offers you the promotion. New title, more money, your own set of keys. Every Saturday is gone for a year.
cards.teenPrompt: Your club or team wants you as captain next year. Your name on everything. Every Saturday, gone.

options.t: Yes. Already practicing the new title out loud.
Counteroffer: every other Saturday off. Rehearsed it in the mirror.
Pass. Keep my Saturdays. Wonder 'what if' sometimes.
Point them to the person who's wanted it for months.

cards.mask: looks like a promotion or captaincy dilemma; measures visible wins versus time outside work or school (L2, T16)

friend.prompt: {name} is offered the promotion, but every Saturday is gone for a year. {name}…

cards.prompt: Remember the last time your part was done (group project, shift, club thing) and someone asked you to stay and help with theirs? It could have waited till tomorrow.

options.t: Did their part while they watched. Faster that way.
Said 'ten minutes.' Left three hours later.
'Got a thing tonight.' The thing: my couch.
Sent my notes and a 'you got this,' then logged off.
Stayed. Where I am, nobody leaves first.

cards.mask: looks like a work-ethic question; measures whether someone else's ask overrides your own limit (T06, capacity: tag only, never R2)

friend.prompt: {name}'s part is done. Someone asks {name} to stay and help with theirs, though it could wait. {name}…

b.t: Claims a plan tonight. The plan is the couch.

cards.prompt: Five years from now, you overhear two people talking about you. Pick the two lines you'd most want to catch.

options.t: Made a thing strangers use every day.
Richer than everyone who doubted them.
Always down for a 2am food run.
Somehow always on vacation.
Has a ten-year plan. Laminated.
Changed plans four times. Happier every time.

cards.mask: looks like overheard gossip about future you; measures visible wins versus a life at your own pace (L2, T16) with a timeline read (T17)

friend.prompt: Five years from now, someone describes {name} in one line. Which would {they} rather overhear?

a.t: Made a thing strangers use every day.

cards.prompt: Your own thing (art, reselling, a channel) just had its best month ever. Growing it for real would take all your savings.
cards.teenPrompt: Your own thing (art, reselling, a channel) just had its best month ever. Growing it for real would take everything you saved this summer.

options.t: Put every cent in. Tell my parents after.
Grow it with what it earns. Savings stay put.
Pick up a steady part-time job to fund it.
Launch preorders. Let the fans pay for round two.

cards.mask: looks like a side-hustle fork; measures betting your savings on your own thing versus keeping the cushion (L1, T13, Sally Q19). The part-time job line keeps Sally Q17 A (steady pay funds the interest). Fix pass round 2 took the job offer out so chapter 5 no longer has three work offers in five cards, and dropped the money circumstance

friend.prompt: {name}'s own thing just had its best month ever. Growing it would take all {name}'s savings. {name}…

b.t: Grows it with what it earns. Savings stay put.

cards.prompt: The last time someone your age had big news: dream school, dream job, the big move. Maybe a parent forwarded it. No caption.

options.t: Double-tapped. Forgot it by the next video.
Opened my notes app and started a plan.
Sent it to a friend: 'wait, are we behind?'
Muted them for a week. Not today.

cards.mask: looks like a scroll moment; measures how much other people's milestones set your own clock (L2, T17), with a slight read on whether visible wins matter to you (T16: shrugging it off versus muting it out of envy)

friend.prompt: Someone {name}'s age posts huge news: dream job, dream school. What would {they} do?

a.t: Double-tap and forget it by the next video.

cards.prompt: That news. First thing in your chest?

options.t: Happy for them. Like, actually.
A tiny sting. Why not me yet?
Pressure. Suddenly my own plans felt slow.
Relief that my life isn't on a schedule.
Cringe at the caption, honestly.

cards.mask: looks like a mood check; records the emotion under the timeline answer (emotion only, never profile evidence)

cards.prompt: Your flight's delayed four hours. The gate has wifi and exactly one free outlet.

options.t: Laptop out. Ahead on everything by boarding.
Finally plan the side project in my notes.
Neck pillow on. Asleep at the gate.
Walk every terminal like it's a museum.

cards.mask: looks like killing time at the airport; checks the default pull toward getting ahead versus resting (L2). Plays in the finale, slot 4, per the flow order
